definitions.explanation: A series of connected mountain peaks forming a continuous ridge or chain. Used to describe prominent mountain formations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧アルプス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連峰|れんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The mountain range of the Northern Alps is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶった→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧{連峰|れんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A snow-capped mountain range can be seen in the distance.

examples.japanese: {登山家|とざんか}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五日間|いつかかん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{連峰|れんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦走|じゅうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The mountaineers made a plan to traverse the mountain range over five days.

notes:
Describes a chain of connected peaks. Common in names of specific mountain ranges in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連峰|れんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦走|じゅうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to traverse a mountain range)
- {連峰|れんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (to gaze at a mountain range)
- {連峰|れんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稜線|りょうせん} (ridgeline of a mountain range)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連峰|れんぽう}: chain of mountain peaks (emphasizes connected summits)
- ⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧: mountain range (larger scale, geological term)
- {山並|やまな}み: row of mountains (visual impression)
